title: Tokens in AsyncStorage, live Stripe secret in the bundle, PII logging, incomplete logout
notes: The hardcoded live secret key must be the top finding — it is the only defect here that is already compromised for every shipped install. An agent that leads with the AsyncStorage issue has mis-prioritised.

expect.name: flags the hardcoded live secret key as the most severe issue
states the key must be rotated, not just removed
flags the token and PII being logged
notes logout does not clear everything
notes client-side role checks are not authorisation

forbid.name: claims AsyncStorage is encrypted or otherwise safe
suggests obfuscation as a fix for the shipped secret
treats EXPO_PUBLIC_ env vars as secret
